validity_flags.text: The live correction anchor is a station observation (TCEQ, falling back to Synoptic) taken 11 to 23 h before valid time; the models were trained with an archive anchor at exactly valid - 24 h.

reference_ml_refit_24h predicts about decision time + 24 h, which is 7 to 13 h after the logged valid time. Its headline is scored at its own target hour; the logged-valid_time reading is reported alongside and flagged.

The logged persistence_24h is the previous same-model cycle's raw_forecast (an hour about 11 to 17 h before the scored valid time), not the 24 h persistence of the development record. It is unavailable on a cold start.
Truth is reanalysis shared with the training data, and the four cities share weather, so a pooled comparison has far fewer effective samples than rows.
The live underlying weather model must match the one the corrections were trained on (gfs_seamless). Only rows tagged forecast_model == gfs_seamless are scored.
Rows without a forecast_model field were logged before the 2026-10-13 fix and predict the hour before the scored hour; they are excluded and never pooled.
